title: docs(spec): the currency-chain text states the fixed-mode condition — spec sites 5–10 of the currency-mode closure
body:
Part of #20126
Clause-②: no

This PR covers remainder (b) of the currency-mode class-closure card: sites 5–10, appended by the seat in comment 5853407641 and kept in this lane by triage (5853734589). It does not close the card. What stays open is listed under **Remainder** at the end.

## What was wrong

`CurrencyConfigSchema` declares two modes. Under `currencyMode: 'fixed'`, the field has one currency, `defaultCurrency`. Under `dynamic` (the default), the field has no currency of its own: amounts display in the tenant default currency (`localization.currency`), or as a plain number when none is set, and `defaultCurrency` is not read, including its parse default `CNY`. The value is a bare number either way (ADR-0104).

The readers were re-measured for this PR, and each reads `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`:

- **Analytics relay**, at base `1c8b320a8`. `AnalyticsServicePlugin`'s `sourceFieldMeta` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts`, the `fixedCurrency` ternary) answers `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` only when `currencyMode === 'fixed'`, and `undefined` otherwise. `queryDataset` then resolves `mc.currency ?? meta?.defaultCurrency ?? context?.currency`. `context.currency` is the tenant `localization.currency` (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts`).
- **objectui's `resolveFieldCurrency`**, at objectui `main` `25c7d584`. `packages/i18n/src/currency.ts:60` takes `config.defaultCurrency` only under `currencyMode === 'fixed'`.

Six texts under `packages/spec/**` and `examples/**` still described an unconditioned `defaultCurrency` step, or called the chain "ADR-0053". ADR-0053 is the date / datetime semantics record and never names currency.

## What changed: text only, site by site

**Site 5, `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts`, the `AnalyticsResult.fields[].currency` TSDoc.** It ships in the published `.d.ts`. The ADR-0053 label is gone. The middle step is now "the source field's FIXED currency (`currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`, read only under `currencyMode: 'fixed'` — a `dynamic` field has no currency of its own, so its `defaultCurrency` is not read)". The text cites `CurrencyConfigSchema` and ADR-0104, and it says the column is also absent when no step answers. The date-bucketing `ADR-0053 Phase 2` citation in the same file (now `:300`) really is a date use, and is untouched.

**Site 6, `packages/spec/src/data/percent-scale.ts`, module header.** "This mirrors the ADR-0053 currency chain" now reads "This mirrors the currency chain", with the three steps and the fixed condition spelled out.

**Site 7, `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`, `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema` docblock.** "(the ADR-0053 / percent-scale renderer chains)" now reads "(the currency / percent-scale renderer chains)".

**Site 7, in-class extra in the same file: the `data.fields[].currency` describe.** This is the `.describe()` mirror of site 5, and it said "source-field default" with no mode:

- FROM: ``Resolved ISO 4217 code for a MONETARY measure (explicit measure `currency`, then source-field default, then tenant default). Absent on non-monetary columns, which must never render a symbol.``
- TO: ``Resolved ISO 4217 code for a MONETARY measure (explicit measure `currency`, then the source field's fixed currency — its `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`, read only under `currencyMode: 'fixed'` — then the tenant default). Absent on non-monetary columns, which must never render a symbol.``

**Site 8, `packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json` (`currency`) and `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` (`currencyConfig`).** Evidence text is hand-maintained. `check:liveness` resolves its paths and `#symbol` anchors, and `gen:liveness-counts` tallies statuses only, so the owning route is a hand edit gated by `check:liveness`.

- `dataset.json`: the evidence drops the ADR-0053 label and names the middle step "the source field's FIXED currency". It gains a gate-checked anchor at the relay, `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts#AnalyticsServicePlugin`.
- `field.json`: re-measured at objectui `25c7d584`, and the pointers moved with the code: `currency.ts` `:32` → `:60`, and `CurrencyField.tsx` `:45`/`:51` → `:55`/`:91`. At the old pin `11c1e71e` the read was unconditioned, so rewording the text without re-measuring would have pinned a false sentence to that sha.
- Both rows get `verifiedAt` re-dated to 2026-09-27 and a dated note. **Both verdicts stay `live`**; no measurement falsified either one. `state-counts.md` is unchanged.

**Site 9, `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:447`, the `defaultCurrency` describe string only.** The `.default('CNY')` and every other line of the region-split file are untouched. The diff is one line.

- FROM: `Default or fixed currency code (ISO 4217, e.g., USD, CNY, EUR)`
- TO: ``The currency code (ISO 4217, e.g. USD, CNY, EUR) of a `fixed`-mode field: its one currency. Not read under `dynamic` (the default), where amounts display in the tenant default currency.``

`gen:docs` regenerated the two matching rows of `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx`. `check:generated` proved that one artifact stale, and no other.

**Site 10, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/chart-gallery.dataset.ts`.** The comment stated the chain with no mode, cited ADR-0053, and spelled the key as a `default-` / `Currency` wrap, so a line grep for `defaultCurrency` missed it. It also told authors to "set a field `currencyConfig`" to pin a symbol, which pins nothing without `currencyMode: 'fixed'`. `project.budget` / `spent` declare no `currencyConfig` at all, since `Field.currency()` injects none. The comment now states the conditioned chain and the fixed form an author would actually write.

### In-class extras found by the census, fixed in place

All four conditions of the bounded in-place rule hold for these:
- they are the same defect class;
- each is a mechanical one-phrase text change;
- no other claim holds the files (all 10 open non-release PRs' file lists were read, and none touches any file here; #20011's `field.zod.ts` hunks are at `:29` and `:2306`);
- there is no new verification surface.

The extras:

- `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`, the `fields[].currency` describe (above).
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/account.object.ts:63` and `semantic-zoo.object.ts:53`: "spec channel: `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`" gains "read only under `currencyMode: 'fixed'`". Both fields already declare `'fixed'`.
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:125`: "currencyConfig.defaultCurrency drives a real $ symbol" now reads "the fixed-mode currencyConfig.defaultCurrency (USD)". The field is `semantic-zoo.budget`, `fixed` / USD.
- `packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts:176`: this test-block comment names `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` as the declarable nested form. It now adds "under `currencyMode: 'fixed'` — the only mode that reads it". It is a comment only, with no assertion change.

## Census: the seed for remainder (c)

Instrument: a scratchpad script (not committed) that reads each file at a git ref. The scopes are `packages/spec/src/**`, `packages/spec/liveness/**` and `examples/**`: 1881 files at both refs. Base is `1c8b320a8`. Head is `6ff1a15c`, the final head after merging `main` `e7f69dbb`; it reads identically to the pre-merge head `452bd5d4`.

| Reading | Base | Head |
|---|---|---|
| `ADR-0053` within five lines of `currenc` | **6** (the six site lines) | **0** |
| `defaultCurrency` lines | 79 | 86 (the corrected text adds lines) |
| `default-` / `Currency` wrapped tokens, which a line grep misses | 1 (site 10) | 0 |

**Controls.**
- The base reading of 6 is the lit leg of the same instrument.
- 38 `ADR-0053` lines remain in these scopes at head. All are date uses outside the window: `analytics-service.ts:300` (date bucketing, the `:294` the order excluded, shifted by this diff) and `execution-context.zod.ts:91` (timezone, ADR-0053 Phase 2). No genuine date-bucketing use falls inside the window.

**Sentence-level judgment at head.** Every prose sentence naming `defaultCurrency` in these scopes carries the `fixed` condition or says it is not read under `dynamic`:

| Sentence | Where |
|---|---|
| Corrected by this PR | `field.zod.ts:446`, `:447`, `:460`–`:463`, `:1060`, `:1066`–`:1068`; `analytics.zod.ts:111`–`:116`; `analytics-service.ts:79`–`:90`; `percent-scale.ts:14`–`:18`; both ledger rows; `chart-gallery.dataset.ts:44`–`:51`; `account.object.ts:63`; `semantic-zoo.object.ts:53`; `detail-shapes.spec.ts:125`; `field.test.ts:176` |
| Code, not sentences | the `aliases` map (`field.zod.ts:427`), the precision-check code (`:465`, `:505`, `:512`, `:2327`), and every test fixture |
| Judged pass, flagged for the pin's author | `field.test.ts:202`, the `it` title "names the declarable nested form, `currencyConfig` / `defaultCurrency`". It labels exactly what its assertions check (the refusal message contains both tokens), and its body parses the `fixed` form. Retitling it to claim `fixed` would need a new message assertion, which is outside a text-only PR. A pin that scans test titles should decide this line deliberately. |

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/semantic-zoo.object.ts:54`–`:55` says a bare field-level `currency` key "gets stripped at parse". `FieldSchema` refuses it: `field.test.ts:198` pins `success: false`, and the guidance message is at `field.zod.ts:1066`. This is a different defect class, left untouched.
- Released CHANGELOG entries still say "ADR-0053 currency chain": `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` `:28383` and `:66160`, and `packages/services/service-analytics/CHANGELOG.md` `:1976` and `:8504`, all under 17.0.0. These are release-owned. AGENTS.md routes an amendment to a dedicated docs-only PR, never a rider here.
- objectui `25c7d584`, `packages/i18n/src/currency.ts:22` and `packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx:52`, still cite ADR-0053 for the tenant step. `:30` still quotes the spec's pre-#20179 "user selectable" wording. The code is right; the comments are in objectui's lane.

## Verification

All readings are at head `6ff1a15c`: this branch plus a merge of `main` `e7f69dbb`. Main brought no file this PR touches. The branch delta against main is byte-identical before and after the merge: `git patch-id --stable` gives `224b6215` on both.

**Build and tests** (one `os-verify-lock.sh` invocation, `VERDICT command-exit 0`):
- `turbo run build --filter=./packages/* --filter=./packages/*/* --concurrency=2`: "Tasks: 71 successful, 71 total".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated`: "All 15 generated artifacts are up to date". This is the second leg: before `gen:docs`, the same command read "1 of 15 artifact(s) stale: content/docs/references/**", and exactly the 2 `defaultCurrency` rows moved.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: "Test Files 540 passed (540) / Tests 15878 passed | 2 todo (15880)".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, and "check:test-typecheck: OK").
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: "Test Files 29 passed (29) / Tests 384 passed (384)".

**What ships.** The measurement was taken on the built `dist`, with a positive control:
- The new TSDoc is in `dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `dist/percent-scale-*.d.ts` / `.d.mts`.
- Both new describes are in `dist/ui` and `dist/api`.
- "ADR-0053 currency chain" has zero hits in `dist`.
- The `field.test.ts` comment is not shipped.

**Consumer fixture triage.** No test or snapshot pins any changed string. `git grep` for the old describe texts and the old example comments outside their own files gives 0 hits, and the same search over `examples/app-showcase` lights on the edited files as a control. The one generated consumer, `field.mdx`, is regenerated.

**Gates.**
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `6ff1a15c` derives 109 commands (13 paths vs merge base `e7f69dbb`). All 109 were run, each exit code recorded before any pipe, and all 109 exit 0. `--ran` answers "Run reconciliation — 109 derived, 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero: every line carries its exit code).
- The roster families whose roster sits under a touched directory, 6 of them, all exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, spec `check:meta-url-spelling`, spec `check:spec-changes`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- `check:partof-closing-keyword` on this body, offline via `PR_BODY`: exit 0.

**Lint.** The run is narrowed, since CI owns `pnpm lint`. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 9 touched `.ts` files: 9 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored. `--print-config` puts each file in eslint's population, with 4 or 5 rules each. `eslint.config.mjs` sets no `parserOptions.project`, so no type-aware linting runs and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

**Bytes.** A control-byte scan over all 13 files gives grep exit 1 (none); the control fixture is lit. `check:nul-bytes` is in the union.

**Ablation.** None. The diff is text only: describes, TSDoc, ledger text and comments. No assertion or runtime line changed, so there is no negative pin to ablate. The `check:generated` red-then-green above is the regenerated artifact's own two-leg reading.

## Remainder after this PR

- (a) #20196: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, the Tier H site. It is open (`pm:queue`) as this PR opens, per a REST read at 2026-09-27T10:34Z, so this PR is `Part of` and carries no enumerating pin.
- (c) The enumerating pin. It is seeded by the census above: widen the ADR-0053 scope to `packages/spec/src/**`, `packages/spec/liveness/**` and `examples/**`, and judge the sentence, not the line. The wrapped `default-` / `Currency` token this PR removed is one concrete case a line grep cannot see.
